blocks.value: Two smaller features, one shared theme: **making invalid states impossible**.

An enum turns "the grading period is a String, and I hope nobody types `Prilim`" into a value the compiler itself polices. That is the same instinct as encapsulation in Lesson 13, applied to the values themselves rather than to access.
What you will be able to do
By the end of this lesson you will be able to:

items: Declare an enumeration and use its constants
Use the built-in enum methods, instance and static
Control a `switch` structure with an enum
Explain what type safety means and why enums provide it
Identify the four kinds of nested class and when to use one
